propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, admin-enabled) returns 429 responses that are not retried by the current transport, causing hard failures on rate-limited reads
The Retry-After header must be honoured with up to 20% jitter applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, reusing existing _errors utilities
Rate-limit retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in (defaulting OFF) to prevent duplicate-write regressions on mutations

The opt-in flag must propagate through two distinct paths: PATH A (_paged_search → _call_logged → _with_connection_retry) and PATH B (direct _with_connection_retry calls like get_comment_map's per-issue fetch)
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code=429 (never the vendor JIRAError) to maintain the neutral exception contract at the adapter boundary
Four read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map paged and per-issue, get_parent_map) must opt in explicitly; all other transport members retain current no-retry behaviour
